name: meeting2_ml_sync
description: ML product sync. Tests: ML/data jargon (XGBoost, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, ONNX, PyTorch, TensorRT, int8, float16, pgvector), decimals, a rejected proposal, a deferred proposal, an owner-less task with no deadline, an explicit assignment, and a request that is accepted.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Morning everyone. Agenda: the churn model, the ONNX export, and the A/B test for the new recommender.

turns.speaker: Jonas
turns.text: The new XGBoost churn model gets an F1 score of 0.81 on the holdout set, up from 0.74.

turns.speaker: Wei
turns.text: That's good, but the feature pipeline still reads from Snowflake every hour, and the dbt models aren't incremental yet.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Should we make the dbt models incremental before we ship?

turns.speaker: Jonas
turns.text: Yes, I think we need that. Otherwise the Airflow job takes 40 minutes.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Okay, then we make the dbt models incremental before shipping the churn model.

turns.speaker: Wei
turns.text: I'll handle the dbt changes by the end of next sprint.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Next, the ONNX export. Jonas, where are we?

turns.speaker: Jonas
turns.text: The PyTorch model exports to ONNX fine, but with int8 quantization the accuracy drops by 3 percent.

turns.speaker: Wei
turns.text: What if we use TensorRT instead? It usually keeps accuracy better with quantization.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: I'm not sure. We don't have GPU inference servers in production, so TensorRT doesn't help us yet.

turns.speaker: Jonas
turns.text: Right, let's not go down that path.

turns.speaker: Jonas
turns.text: How about we try float16 instead of int8 and measure the latency?

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Let's do that. Jonas, please run that benchmark this week.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Somebody should also write up the quantization results for the wiki.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Last, the A/B test. Wei, can you set up the experiment with a 50/50 split?

turns.speaker: Wei
turns.text: Yes, I'll set it up by Monday, assuming the pgvector index is ready.

turns.speaker: Jonas
turns.text: Should we run the test for two weeks or four?

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Let's leave the duration open until we see the traffic numbers.

turns.speaker: Meera
turns.text: Great, thanks Jonas, thanks Wei. That's it for today.

decisions: Make the dbt models incremental before shipping the churn model
Try float16 instead of int8 quantization and measure the latency
not_decisions: Run the A/B test for two weeks or four

action_items.task: Make the dbt models incremental (dbt changes)
action_items.deadline: by the end of next sprint

action_items.task: Write up the quantization results for the wiki
Set up the A/B test experiment with a 50/50 split
